sql.query: SELECT id FROM tbl_users WHERE id=:userId AND isActive=1 AND isPlatformAdmin=1 LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id moduleId,m.moduleCode,m.moduleName,m.isCore,CAST(:status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL','DISABLED','SUSPENDED','EXPIRED') AS UNSIGNED) validStatus,CAST(:billing IN ('INCLUDED','MONTHLY','ANNUAL','MANUAL') AS UNSIGNED) validBilling,CAST(CASE WHEN m.moduleCode='CORE' AND :coreStatus<>'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS UNSIGNED) coreAllowed,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_module_dependencies d WHERE d.moduleId=m.id AND d.isRequired=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules depTm INNER JOIN tbl_modules depM ON depM.id=depTm.moduleId AND depM.isActive=1 WHERE depTm.tenantId=:tenantId AND depTm.moduleId=d.dependsOnModuleId AND (depTm.status='ACTIVE' OR (depTm.status='TRIAL' AND (depTm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR depTm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) AND (depTm.accessStartDate IS NULL OR depTm.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (depTm.accessEndDate IS NULL OR depTm.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) missingDependencies,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_module_dependencies d INNER JOIN tbl_tenant_modules childTm ON childTm.moduleId=d.moduleId AND childTm.tenantId=:tenantId2 INNER JOIN tbl_modules childM ON childM.id=childTm.moduleId AND childM.isActive=1 WHERE d.dependsOnModuleId=m.id AND d.isRequired=1 AND (childTm.status='ACTIVE' OR (childTm.status='TRIAL' AND (childTm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR childTm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))) activeDependants FROM tbl_modules m WHERE m.id=:moduleId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenants t WHERE t.id=:tenantExists) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.id=:userId AND u.isActive=1 AND u.isPlatformAdmin=1) LIMIT 1

sql.query: SELECT tm.id,tm.status,tm.monthlyPrice,tm.annualPrice,tm.billingInterval,tm.accessStartDate,tm.accessEndDate,tm.trialEndsDate FROM (SELECT :tenantId tenantId,:moduleId moduleId) requested LEFT JOIN tbl_tenant_modules tm ON tm.tenantId=requested.tenantId AND tm.moduleId=requested.moduleId LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO tbl_tenant_modules (tenantId,moduleId,status,accessStartDate,accessEndDate,trialEndsDate,billingInterval,monthlyPrice,annualPrice,currencyCode,billingReference,autoRenew,enabledDate,disabledDate,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId,notes) VALUES (:tenantId,:moduleId,:status,NULLIF(:accessStart,''),NULLIF(:accessEnd,''),NULLIF(:trialEnd,''),:billingInterval,NULLIF(:monthlyPrice,''),NULLIF(:annualPrice,''),:currencyCode,NULLIF(:billingReference,''),:autoRenew,CASE WHEN :enableStatus IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN :disableStatus='DISABLED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END,:createdBy,:modifiedBy,NULLIF(:notes,'')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=LAST_INSERT_ID(id),status=VALUES(status),accessStartDate=VALUES(accessStartDate),accessEndDate=VALUES(accessEndDate),trialEndsDate=VALUES(trialEndsDate),billingInterval=VALUES(billingInterval),monthlyPrice=VALUES(monthlyPrice),annualPrice=VALUES(annualPrice),currencyCode=VALUES(currencyCode),billingReference=VALUES(billingReference),autoRenew=VALUES(autoRenew),enabledDate=CASE WHEN VALUES(status) IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL') AND status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE enabledDate END,disabledDate=CASE WHEN VALUES(status)='DISABLED' AND status<>'DISABLED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN VALUES(status) IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL') THEN NULL ELSE disabledDate END,modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),notes=VALUES(notes),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
SELECT id,tenantId,moduleId,status,monthlyPrice,annualPrice,billingInterval,accessStartDate,accessEndDate,trialEndsDate FROM tbl_tenant_modules WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND moduleId=:moduleId LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO tbl_tenant_module_history (tenantModuleId,tenantId,moduleId,actionCode,previousStatus,newStatus,previousMonthlyPrice,newMonthlyPrice,previousAnnualPrice,newAnnualPrice,changeNote,changedByUserId) VALUES (:tenantModuleId,:tenantId,:moduleId,CASE WHEN :previousStatus='' THEN 'CREATED' WHEN :newStatus='TRIAL' AND :previousStatus2<>'TRIAL' THEN 'TRIAL_STARTED' WHEN :newStatus2='DISABLED' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN :newStatus3='SUSPENDED' THEN 'SUSPENDED' WHEN :newStatus4='ACTIVE' AND :previousStatus3 IN ('DISABLED','SUSPENDED','EXPIRED') THEN 'REACTIVATED' WHEN COALESCE(:oldMonthly,'')<>COALESCE(:newMonthly,'') OR COALESCE(:oldAnnual,'')<>COALESCE(:newAnnual,'') THEN 'PRICE_CHANGED' WHEN COALESCE(:oldBilling,'')<>COALESCE(:newBilling,'') THEN 'BILLING_CHANGED' ELSE 'DATES_CHANGED' END,NULLIF(:previousStatus4,''),:newStatus5,NULLIF(:oldMonthly2,''),NULLIF(:newMonthly2,''),NULLIF(:oldAnnual2,''),NULLIF(:newAnnual2,''),NULLIF(:changeNote,''),:userId)
